originalGroundIDConstantsScope: Original live DS:3458..345e after load, not inferred from the C oracle
authority: Bounded DOSBox-X execution of original DUNE2.EXE and authentic relocated x86 instructions; static source models are not the authority for these expected values
wholeGameScope: Unmodified executable, genuine DOS startup/allocator and save loading. Only INFO.mapSeed in disposable original DOS saves was changed; all 4096 generated baseline IDs (low9bits) are read after load. These are not full Scenario_Load22/8 object+Field snapshots.
rngScope: RNG return bytes and draw counts come from a separately instrumented original-function probe with explicit cleared memory. Whole-game snapshots also matched return bytes, but are not generator-return breakpoints.
surroundingMemoryScope: After-load snapshots show zero bytes immediately after allocation; wrapping negative-neighbor samples contain nonzero partial-rock/wall/rock classes, all non-spice. Snapshots are not observations at every original read time or a universal memory-layout guarantee.

controlledFields.scope: Object-free terrain-only Bloom/Field arithmetic; original Map_Update view/cache callback stubbed, fixed cleared surrounding memory, not full Scenario_Load
